assets.label: Burggruppe - Doppelwohnturm
assets.prompt:
Create ONE transparent Inkarnate worldmap stamp of Burggruppe - Doppelwohnturm — modular medieval Gaelic building cluster.

Use the attached APPROVED ROUND GAELIC FARMHOUSE as the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE. Subject: Two unequal, broad, squat Gaelic stone tower houses connected by a short low residential hall. One chunky round tower with a very broad slate-blue conical roof, one rounded rectangular tower with a low crenellated top, and a simple little linking roof. Pale warm gray stone, almost blank walls and only a couple of small windows. The three buildings form one coherent little castle-core cluster, with no enclosing wall or courtyard floor. Reduce the subject to a few large, clear, slightly irregular shapes. For buildings, favor cozy, chubby proportions, generous simple roofs, almost plain walls and very few doors or windows. Adapt the architecture to the requested motif while retaining the approved cartoonish drawing language. Use the same gently elevated three-quarter map angle as the approved reference. Only a handful of short material marks. Dark-brown outlines carry the design. Warm muted natural colors, gentle paper grain inside the colored shapes only. Two flat tonal values per material, very little shading.

Show ONLY the requested stamp and indispensable attached elements. No extra props or scenery. No individually rendered stones, planks, straw fibers or shingles. No intricate cracks, weathering spots, elaborate ornament, realistic surface rendering or 3D lighting. No extra detail invented to fill the large canvas. Prioritize the simple playful reference shapes above all else. Do not copy the farmhouse subject when another motif is requested.

Entire motif visible, comfortable transparent margin. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; Alpha = 0 outside the motif and in open gaps. No ground patch, scenery, shadow, colored backdrop, paper rectangle, pin frame, text, white outline or halo.

Use the approved farmhouse's gently elevated three-quarter angle consistently; all buildings are upright, same parallel perspective axes, restrained flat shading. Buildings may touch or overlap naturally, but all open spaces between buildings, underneath arches and inside open courtyards must be fully TRANSPARENT. Absolutely NO ground, paving, path, beige floor, grass, base plate, pedestal, surrounding complete wall, scenic border, label or pin frame. Give the group an open irregular outline that allows neighboring stamps to overlap naturally. A few chubby structures only; preserve the very low detail and playful chunky outlines of the farmhouse.
